summary: Code review of WP-004 (HttpMethod union type for Route.method) — PASS.

The implementation is minimal, well-placed, and architecturally sound. HttpMethod is defined as a union type alias directly above the Route interface, which is the correct colocation pattern: consumers never need to hunt for the type definition.

JSDoc on HttpMethod clearly articulates the dual enforcement model (compile-time union + runtime test as defense-in-depth). JSDoc on Route.method cross-references HttpMethod and restates the contract — no ambiguity for future contributors.

dispatchRoute() correctly retains `method: string` for its incoming HTTP request parameter. The widened parameter type is not a bug — it is architecturally correct: raw HTTP method strings from IncomingMessage are unknown at parse time and must be compared against the constrained Route.method union at runtime. The Set<HttpMethod> in the test hardens this boundary from the test side.
No blocking issues found. No Fix-Forward changes applied. One Documentation-Forward note recorded for the test file's module-level comment.
